title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle + vendoring for rke2 Debian-based distros (TUF updates)
author: Maya Patel
description: Add support for Debian-family distro offline bundles for RKE2-based private/on-prem installs. Motivation: customers running RKE2 on Debian/Ubuntu variants (including air-gapped government and telco customers) require a tested offline bundle and vendored dependency set with TUF-signed metadata. This PR adds a new bundle layout under installer/offline-bundles/rke2/debian, vendoring scripts to produce apt archives and container tarballs, TUF signing and verification helpers, and chart/terraform tweaks to allow Debian node mappings. Checklist: - [x] vendor apt packages and container tarballs - [x] add TUF metadata + signing scripts - [x] update redwood-private Helm chart values to allow debian node selectors - [x] terraform module knobs for deb repo mirror config - [x] docs and upgrade notes added (airgap/upgrade paths) Notes: pins rke2 v1.25.11+rke2r1 to match validated kernel modules; includes back-compat shim for older installer tooling. See linked Linear ENG-8124 and support ticket SUP-1456 for customer repro and acceptance criteria.
